title: Jagarin: A Three-Layer Architecture for Hibernating Personal Duty Agents on Mobile
abstract: arXiv:2603.05069v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Personal AI agents face a deployment paradox on mobile: persistent background execution drains the battery and conflicts with platform background limits, yet purely reactive agents miss time-sensitive obligations until the user remembers to ask. We present Jagarin, a three-layer architecture that resolves this through structured hibernation and demand-driven wake. DAWN (Duty-Aware Wake Network) is an on-device scoring engine that runs on the platform's periodic wake and combines four signals (duty-typed optimal action windows, predicted user engagement, the cost of delay, and cross-duty batching) with per-duty adaptive thresholds to decide whether a sleeping agent should stay silent, nudge the user, or offer escalation. ARIA (Agent Relay Identity Architecture) is a commercial email identity proxy that turns institutional email into structured duty records and routes messages by category, removing manual data entry. translated_title: Jagarin：移动设备上休眠式个人责任代理的三层架构
translated_abstract: arXiv:2603.05069v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：个人AI代理在移动设备上面临一个部署悖论：持续的后台运行会消耗电池电量并与平台的后台运行限制相冲突，而纯粹被动响应式的代理则会在用户想起询问之前错过时间敏感的任务义务。我们提出了Jagarin，一种通过结构化休眠和按需唤醒机制来解决这一问题的三层架构。DAWN（责任感知唤醒网络）是一种设备端评分引擎，运行于平台的周期性唤醒之上，它结合四种信号（基于责任类型的最优行动窗口、预测的用户参与度、延迟成本以及跨责任批处理）以及针对每项责任的自适应阈值，来决定处于休眠状态的代理是应该保持静默、提醒用户，还是提供升级处理。ARIA（代理中继身份架构）是一个商业电子邮件身份代理，能够将机构电子邮件转换为结构化的责任记录，并按类别对消息进行路由，从而消除手动数据录入。ACE（以代理为中心……）（注：原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: Jagarin提出由DAWN、ARIA和ACE组成的三层架构，通过结构化休眠与按需唤醒机制，解决个人AI代理在移动设备上“常驻后台耗电、纯被动响应又误事”的部署悖论。
en_tdlr: Jagarin introduces a three-layer architecture (DAWN, ARIA, ACE) that resolves the mobile deployment paradox of personal AI agents through structured hibernation and demand-driven wake-up, balancing battery and platform constraints with timely fulfillment of time-sensitive duties.
